Scenario: Overselling the last unit under concurrent checkout (RC-001)
Preconditions: APP_ENV=testing with a test database; code at app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php:16
Steps: Product 7 has stock = 1. Two clients POST /api/checkout {"product_id":7,"quantity":1} at the same time.
Expected result: one 201 and one 422. Actual: two 201s and stock = -1.

Preconditions: APP_ENV=testing with a test database; code at app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php:21
